title: United for Palestine march in central Nicosia on Israeli actions in Palestine/Lebanon
location: Nicosia; Ledra Street to Eleftheria Square

participants_estimate.evidence_note: CNA page says about 250 joined this march; it is a quantitative event estimate, not a campaign total.

occurrence.value: CNA reports an actual march held on Monday; English page dated 7 Oct and Turkish page dated 8 Oct.

onset.value: Turkish page says event began 18:00 local time on Monday; 7 Oct is supported by English report date/event weekday.

country_location.value: Nicosia, led by Ledra Street toward Eleftheria Square.

domestic_state_target.value: Organizer statement called on Cyprus government to end commercial, business and military cooperation with Israel and stop use of Cyprus ports/airspace for military support.

episode.value: Single reported march. Organizer says the group has held prior-year protests; no evidence of an uninterrupted ongoing episode. Keep this 7 Oct gathering distinct.

violence.value: Unknown; article reports no incident and organizer describes peaceful event, but code only as unknown pending review.

open_questions: Independent reviewer must assess whether single CNA story cluster is sufficient for provisional validation; English/Turkish pages are same-story variants, not independent sources.
Check prior-year campaign context and any October follow-up before deciding episode onset; do not merge with other Q4 marches automatically.
Full CNA English service article is paid; only its public summary was opened.

title: Ekysy pensioners demonstration outside the Finance Ministry

participants_estimate.evidence_note: Source separately reports approximately 500 at the preceding Ekysy annual conference; that count cannot be transferred to demonstration.

occurrence.value: Article reports pensioners held a demonstration outside the Finance Ministry on Thursday 3 Oct.

onset.value: Article date and weekday identify 3 Oct 2024.

simultaneous_threshold.value: Unknown for demonstration. ~500 count is for the annual conference and is expressly not applicable.

domestic_state_target.value: Demonstrators presented demands to government, seeking cost-of-living measures/benefit restoration and a presidential meeting.

episode.value: One demonstration reported; prior lobbying and protests are described over 11 years, but no continuity date/episode mapping is established.

open_questions: Was at least 50 simultaneously present outside the Finance Ministry? The 500-person figure is only the earlier conference.
Are there additional contemporaneous reports with a demonstration-specific count?
Did this action continue beyond 3 Oct?

title: Nurses’ two-hour safety stoppage outside Nicosia General Hospital

occurrence.value: Cyprus Mail says nurses staged a two-hour stoppage outside the hospital on 7 Oct after a safety incident.

onset.value: Page date is 7 Oct and says the stoppage had occurred earlier that day.

simultaneous_threshold.value: No participant estimate; cannot infer crowd from profession or union membership.

domestic_state_target.value: Union demanded state safety action, regulations and greater police presence at A&E departments, naming labour/justice ministries and state health services.

episode.value: Short two-hour action tied to safety event; no report of continuation beyond day.

open_questions: How many nurses attended the outside-hospital stoppage at one time?

Did the public action make a demand that requires state-policy action rather than an employer-only adjustment? The article documents police/health-service policy demands; reviewer should apply codebook threshold.
